Ashley M.: Heads up — OrionCloud just sent a formal notice: ~3 week backlog on 80x A100 nodes for marketplace pools. They flagged a customs reinspection + firmware regression on one batch. cc @SupplyOps. :exclamation:
Maria G.: ugh. which regions impacted?
Ashley M.: EU and APAC shipments affected. US is unaffected. They say 60% stuck in customs queue, 40% on hold for firmware rollback.
Paul T.: can we re-route any allocations from US to EU to cover commitments?
Leo K.: short answer: not without breaking some reserved dedicated commitments. But we might reassign non-SLA test pools.
Eunice C.: list of impacted SKU ids from OrionCloud:
```
SKU: OC-A100-80GB-2026BATCH
batch_ids: [BATCH-3472, BATCH-3473]
status: customs_hold, fw_hold
```
SupplyOps Bot: Noted. Opening incident INC-2026-547 and tagging carriers.
Maria G.: action items: 1) notify marketplace customers with >T2 SLAs 2) attempt swap with partner X for equivalent vRAM 3) free up internal bench/QA GPUs for critical customers
Ashley M.: Paul, Leo — can you scope how many GPUs we can free from bench / non-prod within 48h?
Paul T.: I can free up 24 A100-equivalent from bench; need approval to reduce internal test cadence. :thinking:
Leo K.: I can add another 16 by pausing a low-priority rollout. total = 40.
Ashley M.: ok. that's something. Maria please draft a short customer note, mention ETA uncertainty and that we have short-term mitigations. I'll ping legal for any contractual notices.
Maria G.: Draft posted in #customer-notifications for review. Includes swap offer and credit language. :memo:
Eunice C.: Also exploring an alternate supply lane: vendor Y has 40 units with 1-week lead. starting negotiations now.
Ashley M.: Great. Let's reconvene 24h. If OrionCloud confirms firmware fix, we'll adjust plans. Thanks everyone. :thumbsup:
